title: Bank — Farmers Deposit Bank / First National Bank
text:
BANK.

A few years ago the citizens of Savoy and community put their surplus capital together and organized the Farmers Deposit Bank. It was a paying business from the start and a few years ago the capital was increased to $25,000 and a charter secured for the First National Bank. The deposits were reasonably good and business increased under the management of E. T. Cook and each year the stockholders have realized a divi dend on their investment. Last year Mr. Cook was promoted to the president's chair and J. B. King elected cashier. The bank has been a great help to the town and in fact few small towns can boast of a bank so good. It stood firmly through the money panic and the last statement showed it to be in good shape.
notes: Business/community profile feature from The Elk publication. 'divi dend' is split across a line break in the original.
